home__sr-only1: Jangid Architects: Architecture, Planning and Approvals in Mumbai
home__intro-p1:
We are a consulting and liaisoning & Designing firm with over two decades of experience in the industry, built on the belief that every project deserves the right guidance.
For over two decades, we have been working alongside developers, housing societies, property owners and Consultants, providing end-to-end support in architectural design & Planning, building approvals, statutory compliance, optimum space & FSI utilisation and redevelopment.
home__intro-p2: With our experienced Team and professionals, we bring design, liaisoning and approval processes together. We coordinate with key authorities, including BMC, MHADA, SRA, MBMC, TMC, VVMC and MMRDA, ensuring that every stage of the project is approached with clarity, efficiency and the right expertise.
home__intro-p3: With over 100 successfully completed projects across residential, commercial, redevelopment, SRA, township and interior developments, we bring a wealth of practical experience, technical expertise and a commitment to excellence.
home__services-p2: Building plan submissions and approvals with BMC, MBMC, TMC & VVMC including IOD/IOA, CC and OC.
home__services-p3: Approvals and follow-up for SRA schemes, MHADA and MMRDA SPA Approvals.
home__services-p4: Building plan approvals, Reservation Development Permissions, environmental clearances and other statutory permissions.
home__services-p5: Feasibility, society support and redevelopment planning with approval form IOD to Occupation Certificate Cum Building Completion Certificate.
home__services-p6: Interior design and build for homes, offices and showrooms from planning, Designing to execution.

about__story-p2: Since 2007, Jangid Architects, also known as Jangid Associates (OPC) Pvt. Ltd., has been helping developers, housing societies, property owners and Consultants across Mumbai and MMR turn their plans into reality.
about__story-p3: Our work goes beyond architectural design & Planning. We guide projects through building approvals, including IOD/IOA, CC and OC, statutory code compliance, optimum space & FSI utilisation, and provide redevelopment support through our experienced Team and professionals, coordinating with BMC, MHADA, SRA, MBMC,TMC, VVMC and MMRDA.
about__story-p4: With over 100 successfully completed projects across residential, commercial, redevelopment, SRA, township and interiors, we bring a wealth of practical experience, technical expertise and a commitment to excellence.
about__journey-p2: With growing opportunities and client trust, we moved to a bigger office in Malad and expanded our expertise into BMC, SRA and MHADA projects.
about__expertise-p2: Support for housing societies through feasibility, developer selection, the design of the new building & approvals till OC/BCC.
about__expertise-p3: Slum Rehabilitation Authority housing schemes: scheme Acceptance, DP Reservation Development Permission, LOI/IOA and CC under the SRA framework.
about__expertise-p4: MHADA Society Redevelopment and cluster redevelopment from feasibility and approvals from LOI /IOA to OC/BCC.
about__expertise-p5: Any Development & Redevelopment within Mumbai & Suburbs with planning and approvals handled through BMC from Scrutiny Concessions approval, IOD to OC /BCC.
about__expertise-p8: Feasibility, society support and redevelopment planning with approval form IOD to Occupation Certificate Cum Building Completion Certificate.

article__article-p5: After the building is complete, the owner applies for the Occupancy Certificate. The OC confirms that the building has been built as per the approved plans and is fit for use. occupant cannot legally occupy the building without it, and it is usually needed for permanent water and electricity connections and for the formation of a society.
